item.title: ¿Laura Dogu denunció que un cargamento de medicinas para Venezuela fue desviado a Cuba?

item.title: From Call of Duty to private messages: Amnesty releases reveal some reasons people were detained in Venezuela
item.description: The release of military cadets, a woman jailed after confronting an influencer and a taxi driver detained over a private message offers a window into how digital activity, political pressure and new diplomatic dynamics are reshaping Venezuela’s justice system La entrada From Call of Duty to private messages: Amnesty releases reveal some reasons people were detained in Venezuela se publicó primero en El Diario Venezuela - elDiario.com.
